raw_record.summary: OpenMAIC assistant for setting up, generating, and extending OpenMAIC. Use when the user wants to use OpenMAIC, generate a multi-agent interactive classroom, or build on / extend / customize OpenMAIC and its @openmaic/* SDK (secondary development, 二开) — covers Live Demo or local setup, startup modes, provider keys, classroom generation, and secondary development (forking, providers/storage/themes, routes, or the renderer/editor).
